name: ai-wealth-navigator
description: AI Wealth Navigator - an agentic financial wellness platform (React + Node + AWS Bedrock)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @wealth/server && npm run build --workspace @wealth/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared && tsc --noEmit -p packages/server && tsc --noEmit -p packages/web && tsc --noEmit -p infra
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @wealth/shared && npm run test --workspace @wealth/server && npm run test --workspace @wealth/web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.synth: npm run build && npm run synth --workspace @wealth/infra
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy --workspace @wealth/infra
